claims: "One Battle After Another" won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026, according to the Los Angeles Times and CNN.
Paul Thomas Anderson directed "One Battle After Another".
"One Battle After Another" is a satirical action-thriller.
"One Battle After Another" secured six total Oscars.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for "One Battle After Another".
"One Battle After Another" defeated "Sinners", notes the Los Angeles Times.
"Sinners" won four awards, notes the Los Angeles Times.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for "Sinners", notes the Los Angeles Times.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay for "Sinners", notes the Los Angeles Times.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for her role in "Hamnet", reports the Washington Post.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for "One Battle After Another", notes the Times Union.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony took place on March 15, 2026.
The ceremony highlighted "One Battle After Another" for its intense exploration of American extremism, according to the Los Angeles Times.
